answer: Each agent registers one vine row shelter, locks an 80-credit bond, and pays a filing fee. Before a forecast gale window the operator must close the shelter shutters; auditors then read anemometers inside and outside and compute the wind delta. A closed shelter cuts wind at least 40 percent; an open one shows near-zero delta and burns the bond. The kth filing costs 36+6(k-1), so the 1000th costs 6030; 1000 fakes cost 3033000 plus 80000 in bonds. A rented-shelter ring fails: borrowed readings carry the owner's key. An honest grower pays one fee and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
